titulo.alumno: A source on social media · Media and sources

intro: Part 3: a source on social media. Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

texto: Check the author, the date, the link to the source and the type of evidence. A quotation reproduces a voice; a headline summarises and may simplify. Distinguish «kilden siger» (the source says) from what the outlet concludes.
Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
